feature_definitions.prop_absent_days_90: 1 - (days with ≥1 observed measure / 90 expected calendar days). practiced_sport counts only when activity_walking survived the 120–15000 s filter. A stored 0 with no raw walking and no raw running is not an observed measure.
feature_definitions.n_gaps_ge_48h_90: count of runs of ≥2 consecutive empty calendar days in the 90 d window
feature_definitions.days_since_last_valid_90: empty days at the end of the 90 d window since last day with any measure
feature_definitions.monitoring_interrupted_now: 1 if days_since_last_valid_90 ≥ 2 (ongoing >48 h gap at the decision); no future withdrawal flag

models.availability_only: standardised logistic (L2, C=1) on the four indicators, fitted on the 1013 decisions; Youden cut on the same decisions
models.dcabp_load_frozen: frozen three-block DCABP load; classif at threshold 1.0596…
models.dcabp_logit: same logistic on load alone (ranks as the frozen load)
models.dcabp_plus_availability: same logistic on load + the four indicators

cross_validated_comparison: reviewer's design: availability, load and load + availability logistics with one shared patient-to-fold map (5 folds, seed 20261116); out-of-fold probability of progression; Youden cut from the training folds; paired AUROC difference (load + availability minus load) with patient bootstrap. Output: performance_models_cv.csv
valid_record: a day with at least one of the nine input variables observed after the range filters
evaluation: as the frozen load: fixed scores on the same 1013 decisions, no cross-validation; patient bootstrap CIs; paired AUROC difference vs the frozen load
note: Coordinate with the broader comparator pack; this file is the missingness arm on the same 1013 points.
